items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: It's like that story about the writer Bemelmans he used to have this babysitter who was a child kidnapper.

ctx.x: thief?" I said, yeah. She said, "you sent your daughter to Carnegie Hall with a thief?" I said, he's a nice guy, you know. I don't know he's a thief; just people say he's a thief.

It's like that story about the writer Bemelmans he used to have this babysitter who was a child kidnapper. And he said, how could you leave your child with this known criminal? He said, I know that every policeman in Paris is watching him. I know she's as safe as she could possibly be. I figured with Sonny, my daughter's safe, all the cops had an eye on him.
MR. KOULOVARIS (PHONETIC) was his last name.
